messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'resv-eu-west-2-a' high GPU utilization -> 100% (queue growth). Throttling observed for reserved tenants. Alert severity: P1.

sre-oncall-alex: paging in. I'm oncall. looking at dashboards now.

infra-ryan: i've got the cluster view, confirmed pool at 100% reserved allocation. autoscaler is not adding nodes — hitting scaleLimitErrors in controller logs.

meera: @ryan can you paste the controller log snippet? suspect rate limiter or cloud quota.

infra-ryan: logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:10:02Z autoscaler: scale_request failed: quotaExceeded: cannot allocate GPUs in eu-west-2
2026-03-15T03:10:05Z autoscaler: retry backoff 60s
2026-03-15T03:11:14Z autoscaler: scaling suspended due to rateLimitExceeded
```

eng-ml-jordan: queue length spike on the inference service for reserved-pool routes. 95th pct latency went from 120ms -> 2.3s over last 5m. Token throttles visible.

cs-jamie: customer-reported errors from AtlasFin — multiple customers seeing timeouts in their apps. Jamie from CS standing by to coordinate comms.

atlasfin-ops: we're seeing tail latency spikes and dropped requests. This is customer-facing. any ETA?

sre-oncall-alex: short-term plan: 1) triage autoscaler error source 2) apply emergency routing to move AtlasFin traffic to backup reserved cluster in us-west-1 (if compatible) 3) throttle non-enterprise background jobs and low-tier customers to free slots 4) notify CS for external comms. doing 1) now.

meera: autoscaler is hitting cloud provider quota + internal safety limit that prevents bursting beyond reservedCommit for the pool. there's also a bug where the autoscaler stops retries after 5h; looks like that happened after a flurry of errors last night.

infra-ryan: i've opened a support ticket with cloud to request temporary GPU quota increase. ETA unknown (we have expedited). meanwhile i can temporarily flip the pool safety flag to allow burst up to 20% while we wait. need approval.

sre-oncall-alex: approve temporary burst override. do it and report back. also start routing plan in parallel.

infra-ryan: toggling safety flag: `infra-tool pools update resv-eu-west-2-a --burst 20% --override-reason "P1 reserved starvation"`

incident-bot: deploy started: pool-config-change by infra-ryan. CI run 1/1.

infra-ryan: done. pool reports available GPUs increased by +6 (approx). queue drained by ~40% in 3m.

eng-ml-jordan: nice. latency coming down but still elevated for AtlasFin. there are a bunch of long-running KV-cache warmups from their large-context workloads. those hog instances for longer.

meera: for AtlasFin specifically, recommend two-pronged approach: a) move their critical routes to backup reserved cluster (manual routing override) b) backfill the evicted lower-priority jobs with burst GPUs until autoscaler recovers. i'll prepare routing patch.

sre-oncall-alex: @meera go ahead. @jamie prepare a customer-safe status: say we are mitigating, no data lost, increased capacity, ETA for full recovery ~30-45m.

meera: routing override command:
```
redwood-router set-route --tenant atlasfin --from-pool resv-eu-west-2-a --to-pool resv-us-west-1-b --weight 1.0 --dry-run=false
```
Applying...
Routing applied for heavy paths. failing over long-running requests only. Some sessions need reconnect.

atlasfin-ops: switching to backup - we see requests start hitting us-west-1. some clients will reconnect, putting small retry load. thanks.

eng-ml-jordan: monitoring shows memory pressure on us-west-1-b increasing. it's healthy but keep an eye. also starting a focused eviction of background/low-priority inference jobs using label `tier=background`:
```
kubectl -n inference delete pods -l tier=background --grace-period=30
```

incident-bot: NOTE: Eviction performed by eng-ml-jordan at 03:25 UTC. Estimated freed GPUs: 4.

cs-jamie: messaging draft ready for AtlasFin execs: "We're actively mitigating a capacity pressure event impacting reserved GPUs in eu-west-2. We've applied an emergency burst override and partially failed over critical traffic to a backup cluster; customers may see reconnections. We're monitoring performance and expect normal service in 30–45 minutes. Will follow up with post-incident report." Approve?

sre-oncall-alex: send that now. also include link to status page and mention no data loss.

infra-ryan: cloud support replied: temporary quota provision will take ~2 hours. autoscaler retry bug PR is being prepared by ops team, ETA patch ~2h.

meera: long-term note in thread — need to decouple autoscaler safety from retry window and add circuit-breaker metrics. but that's postmortem.

sre-oncall-alex: current status: pool utilization 84%, queue length decimated to baseline. AtlasFin critical routes 80% on us-west-1 now. throttling metrics reduced.

atlasfin-ops: performance much improved on our side. thanks team. we'll monitor and escalate if anything else.

cs-jamie: AtlasFin notified. they asked for follow-up on root cause and timeline for permanent fix — i'll collect and route to them after incident.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P2 at 03:40 UTC.

meera: actions remaining before close: 1) autoscaler bugfix PR and canary deploy 2) cloud quota follow-up 3) ensure burst override is time-limited and audited 4) run replay to evaluate impact of evictions 5) postmortem doc with customer impact window and recommendation to expand reserved buffer for enterprise tenants. I'll own #1 and #5.

sre-oncall-alex: i'll do a timeline recap and handoff to oncall-next. tagging @sre-oncall-maya for follow-up.

eng-ml-jordan: putting metrics and logs into incident S3: s3://redwood-incidents/2114559999/ for post-incident analysis. includes slow request traces, eviction logs, and autoscaler logs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: All critical mitigations in place. final note: keep the burst override until cloud quota confirmed; remove after patch.

sre-oncall-alex: closing thread, will update postmortem when complete. great work everyone :thumbsup:
